title: Raccoon eating a snack
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- raccoon body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='72' rx='24' ry='20' fill='#5b6b8c'/>
  <!-- lighter belly -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='76' rx='14' ry='13' fill='#8a9bc4'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='44' r='20' fill='#6f80a6'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <circle cx='33' cy='28' r='8' fill='#5b6b8c'/>
  <circle cx='33' cy='28' r='4.5' fill='#e8a0b4'/>
  <circle cx='67' cy='28' r='8' fill='#5b6b8c'/>
  <circle cx='67' cy='28' r='4.5' fill='#e8a0b4'/>
  <!-- light face mask around eyes -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='46' rx='17' ry='12' fill='#a9b8d8'/>
  <!-- dark eye mask patches -->
  <ellipse cx='41' cy='43' rx='7.5' ry='6' fill='#3b4666'/>
  <ellipse cx='59' cy='43' rx='7.5' ry='6' fill='#3b4666'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='41' cy='42' r='2.6' fill='#fffbe8'/>
  <circle cx='59' cy='42' r='2.6' fill='#fffbe8'/>
  <circle cx='41.7' cy='42.4' r='1.2' fill='#1b2240'/>
  <circle cx='59.7' cy='42.4' r='1.2' fill='#1b2240'/>
  <!-- muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='54' rx='8' ry='6' fill='#eef2ff'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='51.5' r='2.4' fill='#3b4666'/>
  <!-- mouth -->
  <path d='M46 56 Q50 60 54 56' fill='none' stroke='#3b4666' stroke-width='1.6' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- snack: a cookie -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='63' r='6' fill='#d9a65e'/>
  <circle cx='48' cy='61' r='1.1' fill='#6b4a2a'/>
  <circle cx='52' cy='62' r='1.1' fill='#6b4a2a'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='65.5' r='1.1' fill='#6b4a2a'/>
  <!-- arms holding snack -->
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='64' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#5b6b8c' transform='rotate(-20 40 64)'/>
  <ellipse cx='60' cy='64' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#5b6b8c' transform='rotate(20 60 64)'/>
  <!-- paws -->
  <circle cx='45' cy='61' r='3.4' fill='#3b4666'/>
  <circle cx='55' cy='61' r='3.4' fill='#3b4666'/>
  <!-- tail -->
  <path d='M72 82 Q90 78 86 62 Q84 54 76 56' fill='none' stroke='#5b6b8c' stroke-width='9' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M72 82 Q90 78 86 62 Q84 54 76 56' fill='none' stroke='#a9b8d8' stroke-width='9' stroke-linecap='round' stroke-dasharray='4 7'/>
</svg>
